Check Out Our Spacious 1-2 Bedroom Floor Plans

Pet-Friendly with Must-Have Amenities — Rise at Bedford 

Step into a life of meaning at Rise Bedford Lake, where our newly renovated apartment homes are crafted with your comfort in mind. Each home features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and contemporary cabinets with stylish backsplashes and brushed nickel hardware. Enjoy modern conveniences like high-speed internet access, all-electric kitchens, and in-home washers and dryers. Our apartments feature large bedrooms, walk-in closets, and wood-plank style vinyl flooring, ensuring both functionality and elegance.

Don't miss out—schedule your tour today to see our platinum finish renovations and make Rise Bedford Lake your new home!
